name: Armac Locação, Logística e Serviços S.A.
summary: Armac Locação, Logística e Serviços S.A. is a Brazilian enterprise focused on the rental and leasing of a wide array of industrial and heavy equipment. Its comprehensive inventory features construction machinery such as pavers, excavators, motor graders, and compactors, alongside versatile tools like telescopic handlers, wheel loaders, backhoe loaders, skid steers, mini excavators, trucks, and elevating platforms. The company provides crucial support to diverse sectors, including agribusiness, civil construction, infrastructure development, and mining. Furthermore, Armac serves specialized needs in port and rail cargo handling, sugar and alcohol production, biomass management, fertilizer blending, and forestry operations. Established in 1994, Armac maintains its corporate headquarters in Cotia, Brazil.
